Subject: Application for Open Fifth-Face Position, Mount Rushmore National Memorial

Dear Hiring Official:

I respectfully submit this letter as a formal application for the open Fifth-Face position at Mount Rushmore National Memorial. I understand the National Park Service’s mission to preserve unimpaired the natural and cultural resources and values of the National Park System for the enjoyment, education, and inspiration of this and future generations. I further recognize the heightened public trust, operational discipline, and intergovernmental coordination required for any work affecting an icon of national significance. I am prepared to meet those expectations and to serve in strict accordance with applicable federal standards, safety requirements, and ethical obligations.

I offer qualifications aligned with the duties reasonably associated with a high-visibility, permanent commemorative installation on federal property, including: (1) the ability to represent the United States and its democratic ideals with professionalism and dignity; (2) proven capacity to perform under sustained public attention and scrutiny; (3) readiness to coordinate with stakeholders, including NPS leadership, cultural resource specialists, tribal and community partners, and public-affairs personnel; and (4) commitment to compliance with all applicable policies, including standards of conduct for federal service, security protocols, and resource-protection directives. I am also prepared to complete any required background investigation, medical clearance, and onboarding requirements, and to adhere to all restrictions and guidance regarding public statements, media engagements, and official representation.

In addition, I bring a demonstrated record of reliability, sound judgment, and effective communication in formal settings. I am attentive to chain-of-command, responsive to supervisory direction, and capable of maintaining a consistent, mission-focused posture during periods of heightened public interest. I understand that the position entails enduring symbolic responsibilities and that performance expectations would include sustained professionalism, respect for the memorial landscape, and alignment with the interpretive and educational priorities of the National Park Service.

Enclosed/attached are my résumé and supporting materials for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications and availability, and to provide any additional documentation the National Park Service may require. Please contact me at
